headline: Congress named a Houston-area post office building after Deputy Sandeep Singh Dhaliwal, a Harris County sheriff's deputy.
what_it_does: This law renames the United States Postal Service facility at 315 Addicks Howell Road in Houston, Texas. The building is now officially called the Deputy Sandeep Singh Dhaliwal Post Office Building. It is a naming measure and does not change how the post office operates.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2020, and the renaming took effect on that date.
